message.content:
**UNO – Quick‑Start Rules** | Step | What Happens | |------|--------------| | **1️⃣ Setup** | • Shuffle all 108 UNO cards.
• Deal each player 7 cards face down.
• Place remaining cards as draw pile, flip top card to start discard pile.
• Player left of dealer starts first. | | **2️⃣ Turn Order** | • Play proceeds clockwise unless reversed.
• Each turn you may either match the top discard’s color or value with one of your hand cards *or* play a Wild/Wild Draw Four if you have none matching. | | **3️⃣ Card Types & Effects** | - **Number Cards:** Match on same color or number.
- **Skip (+0):** Next player loses their turn.
- **Reverse (+0):** Reverses direction of play.
- **Draw Two (+2):** Next player draws two cards then skips.\n- **Wild (+W):** You choose new color.
- **Wild Draw Four (+WD4):** Choose color + next player draws four cards. Must only be played when you truly cannot follow suit/number—otherwise it can be challenged. | | **4️⃣ Winning a Round** | First player to empty their hand wins round. They score points based on opponent hands:
• Number cards count face value
• Skip/Reversal = 20 pts
• Draw Two = 50 pts
• Wild = 100 pts
• Wild Draw Four = 250 pts | | **5️⃣ Game End** | Keep playing rounds until someone reaches at least 500 total points (you can set another target). That person is overall winner. | --- ### Handy Tips - If you’re forced to pick from the draw pile because you can't play, keep drawing until you find something playable. - When using a Wild Draw Four, remember opponents can challenge if they suspect you had a legal move. A failed challenge forces you to draw six instead! Enjoy your UNO session!
